results.content: # Trump approval sinks to new low in Fox News poll. President Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a new low in Fox News polling, as voters express deep dissatisfaction with his handling of inflation and the economy and Democrats widen their advantage ahead of November's midterm elections. The survey, released Oct. 14, found Trump's approval rating at 36%, while 64% of registered voters said they disapproved of his job performance. According to Fox News, that marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in the network's polling during either of his two terms in the White House. According to the poll, 77% of voters disapproved of Trump's handling of inflation. Fox News
results.title: Trump approval sinks to new low in Fox News poll - USA Today

results.content: Three national polls show President Trump's approval rating hitting new lows as Democrats lead Republicans by 8 to 10 points ahead of the midterms. * Democrats lead Republicans by eight points in the Post poll, nine points in Fox's and 10 points in NBC's among registered voters. Just 21% approve of his handling of the cost of living in the Post poll, 27% in NBC's and 22% approve of his handling of inflation in Fox's. * Even Republicans are souring: Fox and NBC both find Trump's approval among Republicans at 76%, while the Post puts it at 79%. * The Post poll also says 37% of Republicans and Republican-leaning independents want GOP leaders to take the party in a different direction from Trump

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 (Reuters) - President Donald ‌Trump's approval rating fell to a record low as Americans worried about high gasoline prices and appeared ready to punish his Republican Party in the November 3 congressional elections, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday.

Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's ​performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in ​either of his presidential terms, the four-day poll showed.
